title: Directions EMEA 2025
summary: A conference attendee reflects on Directions EMEA 2025, highlighting agentic AI as the central theme and covering practical insights from development sessions on topics like GitHub versus Azure DevOps, building knowledge-first AI workflows, and implementing AI agents in Business Central. The post emphasizes how AI tools have become practical and applicable to daily development work beyond just coding.
key_points: Agentic AI moved from theoretical to practical this year, with real-world examples showing implementation across development, requirements gathering, and documentation
The conference featured new dedicated Development, Leadership, and Consulting zones with informal, close-knit session formats that felt more personal than traditional conference sessions
Multiple sessions highlighted GitHub's advantages and Copilot integration as reasons to move from Azure DevOps, offering a hybrid approach for best functionality
Working with agentic AI requires managing unpredictable outcomes by establishing workflows with proper knowledge and context to guide the AI effectively

quotes.text: now, with tools becoming available and real world examples everywhere, I see how I can use it in my daily work
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the shift from AI as potential to AI as immediately applicable in professional contexts

quotes.text: You need to implement Agents now! …But what even is an Agent?
quotes.why_it_matters: Captures the urgent practical question facing Business Central developers about agent implementation
